title: Delayed recognition of primary thyroid lymphoma with progressive thyroid enlargement and cardiopulmonary symptoms

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Delayed recognition of primary thyroid lymphoma with progressive thyroid enlargement and cardiopulmonary symptoms》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Primary thyroid lymphoma (PTL) is a rare thyroid malignancy that may present with respiratory symptoms overlapping with cardiopulmonary disease, contributing to delayed diagnosis.

evidence.text: Primary thyroid lymphoma (PTL) is a rare thyroid malignancy that may present with respiratory symptoms overlapping with cardiopulmonary disease, contributing to delayed diagnosis.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Delayed recognition of primary thyroid lymphoma with progressive thyroid enlargement and cardiopulmonary symptoms》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Prior computed tomography imaging obtained during multiple evaluations for cardiopulmonary symptoms incidentally demonstrated subtle thyroid enlargement with progressive interval growth on retrospective review.

【Abstract · abstract-1-9】In patients with persistent respiratory symptoms despite appropriate cardiopulmonary management, careful review of prior imaging is critical because subtle thyroid enlargement may otherwise be overlooked.

evidence.text: Prior computed tomography imaging obtained during multiple evaluations for cardiopulmonary symptoms incidentally demonstrated subtle thyroid enlargement with progressive interval growth on retrospective review.

In patients with persistent respiratory symptoms despite appropriate cardiopulmonary management, careful review of prior imaging is critical because subtle thyroid enlargement may otherwise be overlooked.
